definitions.explanation: An activity or task that is done regularly every day as part of one's routine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日課|にっか}⟦です→です：noentry⟧。
examples.english: Morning jogging is my daily routine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{日課|にっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I make it my daily routine to read the newspaper every day.
examples.notes: 〜を{日課|にっか}にする = to make something one's daily routine

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日課|にっか}⟦だ→だ：noentry⟧。
examples.english: Walking the dog is my father's daily task.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦ラジオ→ラジオ：noentry⟧⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{日課|にっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：noentry⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けている→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother makes it her daily routine to do radio exercises every morning and has been doing it for years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しくても→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧、{日課|にっか}⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{欠|か}かさない→欠かさない：noentry⟧⟦ように→ように：noentry⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Even when I'm busy, I make sure not to skip my daily routine.

notes:
{日課|にっか} refers to activities performed regularly on a daily basis. It often implies a self-imposed routine rather than an obligation.

Common collocations:
- {日課|にっか}にする (to make something a daily routine)
- {日課|にっか}になる (to become a daily routine)
- {日課|にっか}を{続|つづ}ける (to continue one's daily routine)

Similar words:
- {習慣|しゅうかん} (habit) - broader term, not limited to daily activities
- {日々|ひび}の{仕事|しごと} (daily work) - focuses more on work tasks
